title: SubmissionIntegrity billing rule body
description: sprk_policyversion.sprk_rulebody shape for sprk_ruletype = SubmissionIntegrity (ebilling-r1 task 049; D-123, D-125). A SYSTEM rule: never authorable and never evaluated from its body. The body is the strict empty object; the findings (the D-91 invoice-number mismatch and the 047 coding findings) are created directly by the submission job. additionalProperties=false: any member is refused, not ignored.
